_comment: This repository's own run configuration, for `perbo run --ticket` (roadmap item 14).
It is the layer between what a ticket knows and what a run needs: the checks and the
materialisation manifest are properties of the repository, agreed once, not of each piece of
work. Copying them into every ticket's run file was the largest part of the JSON a person had
to hand-write, and it is the friction item 13 was really about.
`publish` is false. A pull request is opened with --publish, deliberately: the flag that
reaches an external repository is typed each time.
`.perbo/config.json` is committed, and `.perbo/principles.md` once a person records one. Ticket records,
worktrees, bundles, quarantine and review state are working state and are ignored (D-076).
`limits` sets this repository's own ceilings on an attempt, over the stall detector and the
per-ticket remediation-round limit that stand everywhere (D-096): 45 minutes of wall clock, and
$15 of spend, which binds only an executor billed per token. It sets no attempt_iterations,
round_iterations or attempt_commands, and nothing defaults them: an iteration is one assistant
message and a command one tool call, and every time one of those ceilings fired here it cut
ordinary work rather than catching a runaway.
The materialisation entry is the textbook ADR-0025 case: .local/corpus-cache is an untracked
directory the test suite needs and Git does not carry, so a fresh worktree runs the evaluation
package's tests against absent clones and six reg-* fixtures fail for a reason unrelated to any
change. Symlinked rather than copied: it is 814 MB and it is not a secret. A secret is always
copied.
`protected_paths` names what judges an attempt on this repository beyond `.perbo/**`, which
the runner always protects: the review policy and the corpus (D-045). They are declared here
rather than in the runner because they are a property of this repository, not of every one.
check_docs is the repository's own validator, pinned so a documentation or decision ticket (D-072) has a deterministic check to pass rather than only a review.

entries.reason: the pinned-fixture clones the evaluation suite reads; untracked, 814 MB, not a secret
